capability.title: Compose Image Prompts
capability.summary: Brief + vertical creative grammar in, structured image prompts out. Deliberately separate from generation: prompts are cheap to review, iterate and cache, while generations are not. The original screenshots coupled these two — splitting them is where most of the cost saving in this system lives.

set_coherence_note.description: The light, palette and lens held constant across the set. Re-stated into each prompt.
